export function useApi<T>(fetcher: () => Promise<T>, deps: unknown[] = []) {
  // ...
  const refetch = useCallback(() => {
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)
    fetcher()
      .then(setData)
      .catch((e) => setError(e.message))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false))
  }, deps)
  // ...
  return { data, loading, error, refetch, setData }
}
